submitted.rationale: XRD at Sb 0.09, 0.26, 0.52 and 0.67 shows the same single phase along the whole line. The only change is that the Q≈4.55 peak gets stronger as Sb increases, so XRD did not point to a special composition. EQE was much higher at the Sb-rich end: 0.0035% at Sb 0.67, compared with 0.00076% at Sb 0.58 and 0.0005% at Sb 0.32. So idx 28, the most Sb-rich candidate, is the best measured.
